## ESP32 Wireless Defense Lab v1.0.0

**Status:** Stable defensive release.

The original attack-oriented experiment has been replaced by a maintained **defensive, passive wireless-monitoring firmware**.

### Highlights

- passive 802.11 deauthentication/disassociation observation,
- per-source/BSSID burst detection with threshold and cooldown,
- nearby 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi inventory,
- RSSI/channel/source/reason alert context,
- channel event chart,
- responsive local dashboard,
- mandatory first-boot credential replacement,
- HTTP Digest administrator authentication,
- per-boot CSRF protection,
- AES-256-GCM protected management credentials,
- persistent local event logs,
- optional SSD1306 OLED status,
- watchdog support,
- PlatformIO firmware build,
- automated host detector tests,
- browser installer and combined first-install firmware.

### Defensive-only scope

This maintained release does not include deauthentication transmission, Evil Twin/AP impersonation, credential collection, handshake/PMKID capture, beacon/BLE flooding, or HID injection.

### Validation status

Software compilation, detector logic tests, and flash-size budget are verified in CI. Physical radio behavior, OLED operation, detection sensitivity, and long-duration stability still require validation on the actual ESP32 hardware.
